newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-NORWAY'S FLO SIGNS CONTRACT WITH CHELSEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NORWAY'S FLO SIGNS CONTRACT WITH CHELSEA.

text.p: Norwegian striker Tore Andre Flo has signed a five-year contract with English premier league club Chelsea on a free transfer from Brann Bergen, Norwegian news agency NTB said.
"The London club does not want to pay a transfer sum for Norway's international striker, but will let him play for Brann until his contract expires on October 31," NTB said.
Chelsea, who play in the English F.A. Cup final on May 17, already have a large foreign contingent including Gianfranco Zola, Roberto di Matteo and Frank Leboeuf.
